ai_news.title: Anthropic Overtakes OpenAI in Revenue, Hitting $30 Billion Annualized Run Rate
ai_news.summary: Anthropic announced its annualized revenue run rate surged to $30 billion by April 2026, surpassing OpenAI's $24–25 billion. The growth — an 80x increase from $87 million in early 2024 — was driven heavily by enterprise API adoption and its agentic coding tool Claude Code, which hit $1 billion in annualized revenue within six months of launch.
ai_news.relevance: Signals that enterprise-focused agentic AI tools are now the dominant revenue driver in the AI industry, overtaking consumer-facing products like ChatGPT.

ai_news.title: DeepSeek Releases V4-Flash: Frontier-Level AI at a Fraction of the Cost
ai_news.summary: DeepSeek released V4-Flash on April 24, 2026 — a 284-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that only activates 13 billion parameters per inference, with a 1 million token context window. It is MIT-licensed and open-source, priced at roughly $0.14/$0.28 per million tokens — approximately 90x cheaper than GPT-5.5 on output.
ai_news.relevance: Demonstrates that open-source AI models can now match frontier proprietary models at dramatically lower cost, reshaping enterprise AI economics.

ai_news.title: Five Eyes Alliance Issues First Joint Agentic AI Security Guidance
ai_news.summary: Cybersecurity agencies from the US (CISA, NSA), UK, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand jointly published a 30-page guidance document warning that agentic AI systems carry significant security risks, including privilege escalation, unintended behavior, and cascading failures across interconnected agents. They recommend incremental deployment, Zero Trust architecture, and mandatory human oversight.
ai_news.relevance: The first coordinated international government response to agentic AI risk, setting a security baseline that enterprises deploying AI agents will likely be expected to follow.

ai_news.title: Stanford AI Index 2026: Global AI Adoption Reaches 17.8% of Working-Age Population
ai_news.summary: Stanford's 2026 AI Index reports that global AI usage grew from 16.3% to 17.8% of the world's working-age population in Q1 2026. The report also highlights that AI performance on complex benchmarks is plateauing, costs of deploying AI have dropped dramatically, and AI investment continues to concentrate in the US and China.
ai_news.relevance: Provides the most comprehensive annual snapshot of where AI stands globally — covering adoption, investment, policy, and technical progress — essential for strategic planning.

ai_news.title: Nature Study: Human Scientists Still Outperform Best AI Agents on Complex Research Tasks
ai_news.summary: A study published in Nature found that even the most advanced AI agents significantly underperform human scientists on complex, multi-step scientific tasks requiring creativity, domain reasoning, and experimental design. While AI excels at narrow sub-tasks, the gap in holistic scientific problem-solving remains large.
ai_news.relevance: Provides an important counterpoint to AI hype by quantifying where human expertise still decisively leads, informing realistic expectations for AI in research and R&D settings.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Spring 2026 Release: Agentforce Builder and Agentic Enterprise Search
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce's Spring '26 release introduces Agentforce Builder, a conversational workspace for building and testing AI agents with low-code and pro-code options. Agentic Enterprise Search unifies searching and action across 200+ external data sources, while Agentic Order Routing allows operations managers to automate order rerouting via AI prompts.
sfdc_news.relevance: Directly impacts how Salesforce users can deploy autonomous AI agents across sales, service, and operations workflows.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Acquires Momentum to Boost Agentforce 360 and Slack for Enterprise Sales
sfdc_news.summary: In February 2026, Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Momentum, a San Francisco-based startup. The acquisition is aimed at enhancing Agentforce 360 and Slack capabilities specifically for enterprise sales teams, deepening AI-driven workflow automation within the Salesforce ecosystem.
sfdc_news.relevance: Expands Salesforce's AI-native sales tooling and tightens integration between Agentforce and Slack for enterprise customers.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Introduces Agentic AI Analytics for the Next Era of Product Experiences
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude launched a suite of AI agents in February 2026 that continuously analyze product usage, surface insights, and recommend real-time actions. The Global Agent allows teams to ask complex questions in plain language, auto-build dashboards, and investigate root causes across funnels and experiments. MCP updates also bring behavioral data into tools like Notion, Figma, GitHub, and Cursor.
sfdc_news.relevance: Transforms Amplitude from a passive analytics tool into an active AI decision-making layer embedded across product and engineering workflows.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Launches Two-Way Shopify Data Sync and eCommerce Enhancements
sfdc_news.summary: Braze announced a complete two-way data integration with Shopify in March 2026, enabling marketers to sync Shopify product attributes (metafields, tags, collections) directly into Braze for deeper personalization. Real-time Braze engagement data also flows back to Shopify, creating a closed-loop customer data pipeline for eCommerce teams.
sfdc_news.relevance: Strengthens Braze's position as a core CRM engagement platform for retail and eCommerce brands using Shopify as their commerce backbone.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Launches AI Visibility 2.0: Sentiment Analysis and AI Perception Tracking
sfdc_news.summary: Released on April 29, 2026, AI Visibility 2.0 goes beyond basic brand presence checks in AI search results. It now tracks how AI models talk about your product, surfaces sentiment and recommendations, and closes the loop by measuring how perception changes over time. Data export and MCP integration are included for actionable follow-through.
sfdc_news.relevance: Gives product and marketing teams a new tool to monitor and improve how their product is represented in AI-driven search and recommendation surfaces.

claude_news.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.7
claude_news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7, now generally available across all Claude products and the API. The model brings significant improvements in advanced software engineering and complex coding tasks, along with substantially better vision capabilities at higher image resolution. Pricing remains the same as Opus 4.6 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
claude_news.relevance: Opus 4.7 is Anthropic's most capable flagship model update to date, directly advancing Claude's coding and vision abilities for enterprise and developer users.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Updates Claude Managed Agents with Three New Features
claude_news.summary: Anthropic announced three new features for Claude Managed Agents, with the headline addition being 'dreaming' — a research preview that extends Claude's memory by reviewing past sessions to identify patterns and enable agents to self-improve over time. This marks a significant step toward persistent, self-optimizing AI agents. The update signals Anthropic's push to make agentic Claude workflows more autonomous and context-aware.
claude_news.relevance: Managed Agents with persistent memory ('dreaming') represent a major leap in Claude's agentic capabilities, enabling longer-horizon autonomous task execution.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Design, a New Product for Creating Quick Visuals
claude_news.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Design, an experimental product that allows users to generate visuals including prototypes, slides, and one-pagers directly within Claude. Powered by Claude Opus 4.7, it is available as a research preview for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise subscribers. The launch positions Claude as a direct competitor to design-focused AI tools.
claude_news.relevance: Claude Design expands Anthropic's product surface into creative and visual work, broadening Claude's utility well beyond text and code tasks.

claude_news.title: Claude Mythos Preview: A Security-Specialized Language Model
claude_news.summary: Anthropic previewed Claude Mythos, a new general-purpose language model that demonstrates exceptional capability in computer security tasks. The model is hosted on Anthropic's red-team research domain, indicating it is purpose-built for security research and offensive/defensive cybersecurity use cases. This is one of the first domain-specialized variants of Claude to be publicly previewed.
claude_news.relevance: Claude Mythos signals Anthropic's move into specialized domain models, with security as the first focus area — relevant to enterprise and government customers.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Doubles Usage Limits and Expands Claude Code with Redesigned Desktop App
claude_news.summary: Anthropic doubled Claude Code and API rate limits for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise tiers, and removed peak-hour reductions for Pro and Max users. Alongside this, Anthropic released a redesigned Claude Code desktop app featuring a new session sidebar, drag-and-drop workspace, integrated terminal and file editor, SSH support on Mac, and an 'auto mode' for safer long-running tasks with fewer interruptions. These changes make Claude Code significantly more usable for heavy, production-level workflows.
claude_news.relevance: Higher limits and an improved desktop app lower friction for teams adopting Claude Code as a core development tool, accelerating enterprise adoption.
